label: ESSENCE_6 exclusions at a root are carried by what its determinations require
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: essential exclusions at a root are carried by its determinations. For every actual concrete root r at w, every ESSENCE_6 condition on r's profile holds of every admissible intrinsic profile q that contains all of r's real determinations and in which no real determination of r requires the lack of some members of q. Equivalently (classically), such a condition can fail at an admissible extension only where some determination of r requires a lack within it. A closure determination ('being such as to have nothing beyond these') counts as a carrier; a negative clause in a nature that no determination carries does not. It is weaker than positivity of root essences, which drops the requirement hypothesis.
